'''"Halcyon Endures"''' was the passcode created by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] to secure the hidden areas of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] [[Jedi enclave (Corellia)|facility]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
